import * as React from "react";
import Card from "@mui/material/Card";
import Container from "@mui/material/Container";
import CardActions from "@mui/material/CardActions";
import CardContent from "@mui/material/CardContent";
import CardMedia from "@mui/material/CardMedia";
import Button from "@mui/material/Button";
import Typography from "@mui/material/Typography";
import Grid from "@mui/material/Grid";
import project1 from "../../assets/project1.png";
import project2 from "../../assets/project2b.png";
import project3 from "../../assets/project3.png";
export default function Project() {
  return (
    <Container
      style={{
        paddingTop: "2rem",
        paddingBottom: "2rem",
        marginTop: "2rem",
        marginBottom: "2rem",
        borderRadius: "10px",
        transition: "all 0.3s linear",
      }}
    >
      <Typography
        variant="h2"
        sx={{
          fontWeight: "bold",
          fontSize: "3rem",
          color: "text",
          marginBottom: "1rem",
          marginTop: "1rem",
          textAlign: "center",
        }}
      >
        Project
      </Typography>
      <Grid justify=" center " container spacing={6}>
        <Grid item>
          <Card
            sx={{
              maxWidth: 350,
              marginTop: "1rem",
              marginBottom: "1rem",
              marginLeft: "auto",
              marginRight: "auto",
              boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              borderRadius: "10px",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
              justifyContent: "center",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project1}
              alt="BaliStuti"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                BaliStuti
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                BaliStuti is a web application that helps you to find the best
                craftman products in Bali. Build with Laravel and Bootstrap.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item>
          <Card
            sx={{
              maxWidth: 350,
              marginTop: "1rem",
              marginBottom: "1rem",
              marginLeft: "auto",
              marginRight: "auto",
              boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              borderRadius: "10px",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
              justifyContent: "center",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project3}
              alt="PetFriend"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                PetFriend
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                PetFriend is a web application that helps you to find the best
                craftman products in Bali. Build with html, css, javascript,
                bootstrap, and laravel.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item>
          <Card
            sx={{
              maxWidth: 350,
              marginTop: "1rem",
              marginBottom: "1rem",
              marginLeft: "auto",
              marginRight: "auto",
              boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              borderRadius: "10px",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
              justifyContent: "center",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project2}
              alt="PetFriend"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                Company Profile
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Bali travel guide responsive company profile website build with
                html, css and javascript. Lorem ipsum dolor sit.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
        <Grid item>
          <Card
            sx={{
              maxWidth: 350,
              marginTop: "1rem",
              marginBottom: "1rem",
              marginLeft: "auto",
              marginRight: "auto",
              boxShadow: "0px 0px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              borderRadius: "10px",
              display: "flex",
              flexDirection: "column",
              justifyContent: "center",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <CardMedia
              component="img"
              height="450"
              image={project2}
              alt="PetFriend"
            />
            <CardContent>
              <Typography gutterBottom variant="h5" component="div">
                Company Profile
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                Bali travel guide responsive company profile website build with
                html, css and javascript. Lorem ipsum dolor sit.
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
            <CardActions>
              <Button size="small">Visit</Button>
            </CardActions>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Container>
  );
}
